---
title: "Lightbox: cross-referenced figures"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/plot.qmd (static image in
# place of the R plot). A cross-referenceable figure's lightbox title is
# its numbered caption, "Figure 1: ...", like the figcaption.
lightbox: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"] > img'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "title=\"Figure\u00a01: What is going on\\? A single chart\\.\""
          - 'id="fig-single" class="quarto-float[^"]*"[\s\S]{0,200}?a href="images/mv-0\.png" class="lightbox"'
        - []
---

![What is going on? A single chart.](images/mv-0.png){#fig-single}

See @fig-single.
